watches.name: B2/Misty Green
watches.description: A touch of the Nordic wild - 38.5 mm titanium elegance for any occasion - Now in Misty Green The B2 is the perfect everyday watch featuring excellent wearability and legibility . The case of the B2 is made of Titanium Grade 5 which makes the watch highly durable, super light and hypoallergenic. The sand blasted finishing gives the watch a sophisticated tool-like satin finish. Measuring 38.5 mm in diameter and only 10.4 mm thick (including crystal), the B2 will suit any wrist while fitting comfortably under a shirt cuff. Water-resistant up to 100 meters. Equipped with a beautiful shrunken calfskin leather strap, handmade in Germany using leather from the famous Perlinger tannery. Our distinctive dials feature a two-layer sandwich construction, with a radial brushed finish on the lower layer and a matte finish on the upper. The contrast between the reflective base and the subdued top creates a striking visual depth. The Swiss Super-Luminova BGW9 is applied between the layers and can be seen through the cut-outs in the upper layer. This dial structure gives the watch complexity while still retaining a clean and uncluttered look. Technical Specifications Case diameter: 38.5 mm Lug to lug: 45.2 mm Lug width: 20 mm Case height: 10.4 mm Case material: Titanium Grade 5 Weight: 53 g Crystal: Flat sapphire with inner anti-reflective coating Movement: Miyota 9039 automatic movement with 42-hour running time Dial: Recessed sandwich dial with Swiss Super-Luminova (BGW9) applied on hour markers Hands: Painted black & white hands with Swiss Super-Luminova (BGW9) Strap: 20 mm calfskin leather strap with a titanium buckle Water resistance: 10 ATM Crown: Screw-down crown (diameter 6 mm) with engraved logo Designed in Finland, assembled in Hong Kong

watches.name: B2/Dark Brown
watches.description: A robust yet elegant 38.5 mm titanium watch for any occasion . The B2 is the perfect everyday watch featuring excellent wearability and legibility . The case of the B2 is made of Titanium Grade 5 which makes the watch highly durable, super light and hypoallergenic. The sand blasted finishing gives the watch a beautiful satin finish that matches the tool-like appearance of the canvas strap. Measuring 38.5 mm in diameter and only 10.4 mm thick (including crystal), the B2 will suit any wrist while fitting comfortably under a shirt cuff. Water-resistant up to 100 meters. Our unique dials have a 2-layer sandwich construction. The lower layer has a radial brushed finishing in three different colour options: Turquoise, Copper and Dark Brown. The upper layer has a matte black finishing that creates a striking contrast against the more reflective lower layer. The white minute markers are printed on the black upper layer to ensure maximum legibility in all situations. The Swiss Super-Luminova BGW9 is applied between the layers and can be seen through the cut-outs in the upper layer. This dial structure gives the watch depth and complexity while still retaining a clean and uncluttered look. Technical Specifications Case diameter: 38.5 mm Lug to lug: 45.2 mm Lug width: 20 mm Case height: 10.4 mm Case material: Titanium Grade 5 Weight: 53 g Crystal: Flat sapphire with inner anti-reflective coating Movement: Miyota 9039 automatic movement with 42-hour running time Dial: Recessed sandwich dial with Swiss Super-Luminova (BGW9) applied on hour markers Hands: Painted black & white hands with Swiss Super-Luminova (BGW9) Straps: Grey canvas strap with inner leather lining and a titanium (Grade 2) buckle Water resistance: 10 ATM Crown: Screw-down crown (diameter 6 mm) with engraved logo Designed in Finland, assembled in Hong Kong
